title: Parabola in Maths - GeeksforGeeks
content:
A parabola is a U-shaped symmetric curve defined as the set of all points that are equidistant from a fixed point called the focus and a fixed line called the directrix. It is one of the four conic sections and has an eccentricity of exactly 1.
